en: Sepia-toned studio portrait of a uniformed military officer with a prominent mustache, wearing a peaked cap and double-breasted tunic with shoulder boards and stand-up collar. The photo has a white border and bears a bold cursive signature across the lower part of the image; in the bottom right corner appears a small studio imprint that seems to read "Salon Strindberg." The style suggests an early 20th‑century military portrait postcard.
